senses.en: the activity of searching an area for minerals or other valuable resources

example.en: Gold prospecting attracted many settlers to the region.
example.zh: 淘金勘探吸引了许多定居者来到该地区。

senses.en: to beat rapidly or strongly (of the heart)

example.en: Her heart began to palpitate with excitement.
example.zh: 她的心因激动而剧烈跳动。

senses.en: to tremble or shake rapidly

example.en: The leaves palpitated in the breeze.
example.zh: 树叶在微风中颤动。

senses.en: a pleasing, harmonious combination of sounds, especially in speech or music

example.en: The poet chose words for their euphony as much as their meaning.
example.zh: 诗人选词时既注重意义，也注重声音的悦耳。

senses.en: a very large supermarket, usually built outside town

example.en: We drove to the hypermarket to buy groceries in bulk.
example.zh: 我们开车去特大型超市大批采购食品杂货。

senses.en: behavior that is honest, moral, and respectable

example.en: Common decency requires that you treat others with respect.
example.zh: 基本的体面要求你尊重他人。

senses.en: polite and socially acceptable behavior

example.en: He had the decency to apologize for his mistake.
example.zh: 他还能知礼道歉，为自己的错误道歉。

senses.en: able to be imagined or believed

example.en: It is conceivable that prices will rise next year.
example.zh: 可以想见明年物价会上涨。

senses.en: to treat someone unfairly or cruelly, especially because of who they are
senses.zh: 使受害；迫害；不公正地对待

example.en: Workers claimed they were victimized for joining the union.
example.zh: 工人们称自己因加入工会而受到不公正对待。

senses.en: not serious; silly or lacking in importance
senses.zh: 轻浮的；无聊的；不严肃的

example.en: He wasted money on frivolous purchases.
example.zh: 他把钱浪费在无聊的购物上。

senses.en: a form of energy that can produce light, heat, and power for machines

example.en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
example.zh: 太阳能板将阳光转化为电能。

senses.en: the flow of electric charge through a wire or circuit

example.en: This material does not conduct electricity.
example.zh: 这种材料不导电。

senses.en: a feeling of excitement or tension

example.en: You could feel the electricity in the room before the announcement.
example.zh: 宣布之前，你能感受到房间里的紧张气氛。

senses.en: the back part of the human foot, below the ankle

example.en: My heel hurts after walking all day.
example.zh: 走了一整天后，我的脚后跟疼。

senses.en: the raised part under the back of a shoe

example.en: The heel of her boot broke.
example.zh: 她靴子的后跟断了。

senses.en: to tilt or lean to one side

example.en: The boat heeled sharply in the wind.
example.zh: 船在风中急剧倾斜。

senses.en: a chemical substance that reacts with a base to form a salt and is often sour

example.en: Lemon juice contains citric acid.
example.zh: 柠檬汁含有柠檬酸。

senses.en: sour in taste

example.en: The unripe apple has an acid taste.
example.zh: 这个未熟的苹果有酸味。

senses.en: harsh or sharply critical in tone

example.en: He replied with an acid remark.
example.zh: 他用一句尖刻的话回应。

senses.en: to give someone a reason or incentive to do something

example.en: The new bonus plan motivates employees to work harder.
example.zh: 新的奖金方案激励员工更加努力工作。

senses.en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and willing to act
senses.zh: 激发积极性；使产生动力

example.en: A good teacher knows how to motivate a quiet class.
example.zh: 好老师知道如何激发安静班级的学习积极性。

senses.en: a long thick piece of wood, metal or concrete used in building

example.en: The workers installed a steel beam to support the roof.
example.zh: 工人们安装了一根钢梁来支撑屋顶。

senses.en: a line of light or energy shining from something

example.en: A beam of sunlight came through the window.
example.zh: 一束阳光透过窗户照进来。

senses.en: to smile widely and happily

example.en: She beamed with pride when her son graduated.
example.zh: 儿子毕业时，她满脸自豪的笑容。

senses.en: to send out light or a signal in one direction

example.en: The satellite beams signals to homes across the country.
example.zh: 这颗卫星向全国的家庭发射信号。

senses.en: A person admired for great courage or outstanding achievements.
senses.zh: 因非凡勇气或杰出成就而受钦佩的人；英雄。

example.en: The firefighter was called a hero after saving the family.
example.zh: 这名消防员救出那家人后被称为英雄。

senses.en: The main character in a story, play, film, or poem.
senses.zh: 故事、戏剧、电影或诗歌中的主角。

example.en: The hero of the novel returns home after many years.
example.zh: 这部小说的主角多年后回到家乡。

senses.en: Higher in position, level, or rank.

example.en: The upper shelf is too high for me to reach.
example.zh: 上层架子太高，我够不着。

senses.en: The part of a shoe or boot above the sole.

example.en: The leather upper of the boot is waterproof.
example.zh: 这双靴子的皮革鞋帮是防水的。

senses.en: An upper berth, especially on a train or ship.

example.en: He booked the upper for the overnight train.
example.zh: 他预订了夜班火车的上铺。

senses.en: producing bright light by absorbing radiation; glowing brightly

example.en: The room was lit by fluorescent lights.
example.zh: 房间由荧光灯照亮。

senses.en: of colors that are very bright and seem to glow

example.en: She wore a fluorescent yellow jacket.
example.zh: 她穿着一件荧光黄的夹克。

senses.en: a fluorescent lamp or light fixture (informal)

example.en: One of the fluorescents in the kitchen needs replacing.
example.zh: 厨房里有一根荧光灯管需要更换。

senses.en: excessive pride in one's appearance or achievements

example.en: Her vanity made her spend hours in front of the mirror.
example.zh: 她的虚荣心让她在镜子前花了几个小时。

senses.en: the quality of being worthless or futile

example.en: He finally saw the vanity of chasing wealth for its own sake.
example.zh: 他终于看清了单纯追逐财富的徒劳。

senses.en: a bathroom cabinet with a mirror and washbasin

example.en: She kept her toothbrush by the bathroom vanity.
example.zh: 她把牙刷放在浴室梳妆台旁。

senses.en: to shine brightly with small flashes of light

example.en: The diamonds sparkled in the sunlight.
example.zh: 钻石在阳光下闪闪发光。

senses.en: a series of small bright flashes of light

example.en: There was a sparkle of excitement in her eyes.
example.zh: 她的眼中闪烁着兴奋的光芒。

senses.en: to be lively, witty, or excellent

example.en: She sparkled in the interview with her confident answers.
example.zh: 她以自信的回答在面试中表现出色。

senses.en: to make something longer

example.en: The tailor lengthened the sleeves of my coat.
example.zh: 裁缝把我大衣的袖子加长了。

senses.en: to become longer

example.en: The days begin to lengthen in spring.
example.zh: 春天白昼开始变长。

senses.en: strongly against something

example.en: They are opposed to building a new road through the park.
example.zh: 他们反对在公园里修建一条新路。

senses.en: in conflict with or completely different from something else

example.en: The two ideas are directly opposed to each other.
example.zh: 这两种观点截然对立。

senses.en: as a regular, usual part of a process or routine

example.en: The equipment is routinely checked before each flight.
example.zh: 设备在每次飞行前都例行检查。

senses.en: an admission that one has done something wrong

example.en: After hours of questioning, he made a full confession to the police.
example.zh: 经过数小时的讯问，他向警方作了彻底供认。

senses.en: the act of telling a priest one's sins in some Christian churches

example.en: She goes to confession every Saturday.
example.zh: 她每周六去告解。

senses.en: the killing of one person by another

example.en: The police are investigating the homicide that occurred last night.
example.zh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的杀人案。

senses.en: a long strip of paved ground at an airport where planes take off and land

example.en: The plane waited on the runway for clearance to take off.
example.zh: 飞机在跑道上等待起飞许可。

senses.en: a long platform that models walk along during a fashion show

example.en: The new collection was shown on the runway in Paris.
example.zh: 新系列服装在巴黎T台上展示。

senses.en: methods or plans used to achieve a goal

example.en: Her negotiation tactics helped close the deal.
example.zh: 她的谈判策略帮助促成了这笔交易。

senses.en: the art of arranging and using military forces in battle

example.en: The general studied the enemy's tactics carefully.
example.zh: 将军仔细研究了敌军的战术。

senses.en: food eaten at one time, or a regular occasion for eating

example.en: We had a wonderful meal at the new restaurant.
example.zh: 我们在那家新餐厅吃了一顿很棒的饭。

senses.en: grain crushed into powder, used for cooking

example.en: This bread is made with corn meal.
example.zh: 这种面包是用玉米粉做的。

senses.en: in a quiet way, with little or no sound

example.en: She closed the door quietly so the baby would not wake up.
example.zh: 她轻轻地关上门，以免吵醒宝宝。

senses.en: in a calm way, without showing strong feelings or attracting attention

example.en: He quietly accepted the decision and moved on.
example.zh: 他平静地接受了这个决定，继续前行。

senses.en: secretly or without others noticing

example.en: The company quietly changed its privacy policy.
example.zh: 这家公司悄悄修改了隐私政策。

senses.en: in a direct and honest way

example.en: She frankly admitted that she had made a mistake.
example.zh: 她坦率地承认自己犯了错误。

senses.en: used to emphasize an honest or blunt opinion

example.en: Frankly, I don't think this plan will work.
example.zh: 老实说，我觉得这个计划行不通。

senses.en: a person who eats human flesh

example.en: Legends tell of cannibals living on the remote island.
example.zh: 传说中，食人者居住在那座偏远的岛上。

senses.en: an animal that eats others of its own kind

example.en: Some spiders are cannibals and eat their own kind.
example.zh: 有些蜘蛛是吃同类的动物。

senses.en: a deep blue-violet color

example.en: The sky turned a deep indigo at dusk.
example.zh: 黄昏时天空变成深靛蓝色。

senses.en: a blue dye obtained from plants or made synthetically

example.en: Denim fabric was traditionally dyed with indigo.
example.zh: 牛仔布传统上用靛蓝染料染色。

senses.en: a tiny amount; the smallest bit

example.en: The news didn't change his opinion a whit.
example.zh: 这消息丝毫没有改变他的看法。

senses.en: producing a good or beneficial effect, especially as a lesson

example.en: The failure had a salutary effect on his attitude.
example.zh: 这次失败对他的态度产生了有益的影响。

senses.en: not proper or socially acceptable

example.en: Laughing at the funeral would be unseemly.
example.zh: 在葬礼上发笑是不合适的。

senses.en: the end of the world, especially in religious belief

example.en: Some cults keep predicting that doomsday is coming next year.
example.zh: 一些邪教不断预言世界末日明年将至。

senses.en: a pungent gas (NH3) used in fertilizers and cleaning products, or its water solution

example.en: The strong smell of ammonia filled the laboratory.
example.zh: 实验室里弥漫着刺鼻的氨气味。

senses.en: a device that connects things that are otherwise incompatible

example.en: I need an adapter to plug this device into the socket.
example.zh: 我需要一个适配器才能把这个设备插进插座。

senses.en: a person who adapts a piece of writing or music for another form

example.en: The adapter turned the novel into a stage play.
example.zh: 这位改编者把那部小说改成了舞台剧。

senses.en: a thought or plan about what to do

example.en: That's a good idea for the weekend.
example.zh: 那是个周末的好主意。

senses.en: a mental concept or understanding of something

example.en: The idea of freedom means different things to different people.
example.zh: 自由的概念对不同的人意味着不同的事情。

senses.en: an opinion or belief

example.en: She has strong ideas about how children should learn.
example.zh: 她对孩子应该如何学习有强烈的看法。

senses.en: the purpose or aim behind something

example.en: The idea behind the project is to save water.
example.zh: 这个项目背后的目的是节约用水。

senses.en: one more additional person or thing

example.en: Would you like another cup of tea?
example.zh: 你想再喝一杯茶吗？

senses.en: a different person or thing

example.en: She moved to another city last year.
example.zh: 她去年搬到了另一座城市。

senses.en: an additional one

example.en: One cookie was good, so I ate another.
example.zh: 一块饼干很好吃，所以我又吃了一块。

senses.en: a different one

example.en: That design is fine, but I prefer another.
example.zh: 那个设计不错，但我更喜欢另一个。

senses.en: the non-physical part of a person that many believe continues after death
senses.zh: 灵魂；许多人相信人死后继续存在的非物质部分

example.en: She prayed for the peace of his soul.
example.zh: 她祈求他的灵魂安息。

senses.en: deep feeling or emotional character

example.en: The singer performed the song with real soul.
example.zh: 这位歌手满怀真情地演唱了这首歌。

senses.en: a person

example.en: Not a soul was in the street.
example.zh: 街上一个人也没有。

senses.en: a style of African American music with strong emotion
senses.zh: 灵魂乐；一种情感强烈的非裔美国人音乐

example.en: They danced all night to classic soul.
example.zh: 他们伴着经典灵魂乐跳了一整夜。

senses.en: the thing or things that belong to us

example.en: That blue car is ours.
example.zh: 那辆蓝色的车是我们的。

senses.en: the achieving of a goal or good result

example.en: Her hard work led to success in the competition.
example.zh: 她的努力使她在比赛中获得了成功。

senses.en: a person or thing that is successful

example.en: The new product was a success.
example.zh: 这个新产品很成功。

senses.en: a fish with pink flesh, often living in the sea and returning to rivers to breed

example.en: We watched salmon leap upstream.
example.zh: 我们看着鲑鱼跃起，向上游游去。

senses.en: the pink flesh of this fish eaten as food

example.en: She ordered grilled salmon with vegetables.
example.zh: 她点了烤三文鱼配蔬菜。

senses.en: having a pale pink-orange color
senses.zh: 鲑鱼粉色的；浅橙粉色的

example.en: He wore a salmon shirt to the party.
example.zh: 他穿了一件浅橙粉色的衬衫去参加聚会。

senses.en: relating to or situated at the edge or border

example.en: The map marks the marginal zones around the lake.
example.zh: 地图标出了湖泊周围的边缘地带。

senses.en: small or barely significant; minimal

example.en: The new policy had only a marginal effect on prices.
example.zh: 新政策对价格的影响微乎其微。

senses.en: written or printed in the margin of a page

example.en: She made marginal notes while reading the report.
example.zh: 她读报告时在页边做了批注。

senses.en: (of land) barely productive or worthwhile to farm

example.en: The farmer stopped growing crops on the marginal land.
example.zh: 农民停止在那片贫瘠的土地上种植作物。

senses.en: a person's child, grandchild, or later relative

example.en: She is a descendant of early settlers.
example.zh: 她是早期移民的后代。

senses.en: to throw something with force or carelessly

example.en: She flung her coat onto the chair.
example.zh: 她把外套猛地扔到椅子上。

senses.en: a short period of doing something for pleasure, especially a brief romantic affair
senses.zh: 短暂的放纵；（短暂的）风流韵事

example.en: They had a brief fling last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天他们有过一段短暂的恋情。

senses.en: to move suddenly and energetically

example.en: He flung his arms up in surprise.
example.zh: 他惊讶地猛地举起双臂。

senses.en: covered with or full of sand

example.en: We walked barefoot across the sandy beach.
example.zh: 我们光着脚走过沙滩。

senses.en: pale yellowish brown in color

example.en: She has sandy hair.
example.zh: 她的头发是浅黄褐色的。

senses.en: to say or make a sound with your voice

example.en: He didn't utter a word during the meeting.
example.zh: 开会期间他一句话也没说。

senses.en: complete and absolute (used as an intensifier)

example.en: The trip was an utter disaster from start to finish.
example.zh: 这次旅行从头到尾是一场彻底的灾难。

senses.en: a difficult situation involving suffering or lack of basic comforts

example.en: The family faced great hardship after losing their home.
example.zh: 失去住房后，这家人陷入了极大的困境。

senses.en: three times as great, or having three parts

example.en: She paid triple the usual price for the ticket.
example.zh: 她为这张票付了平时三倍的价钱。

senses.en: in baseball, a hit that allows the batter to reach third base

example.en: He hit a triple in the seventh inning.
example.zh: 他在第七局击出了一支三垒安打。

senses.en: to increase or make something three times as much
senses.zh: 使增至三倍；（数量）增至三倍

example.en: The company hopes to triple its profits within five years.
example.zh: 公司希望在五年内将利润增至三倍。

senses.en: caused by or capable of spreading infection

example.en: Flu is an infectious disease that spreads quickly in winter.
example.zh: 流感是一种在冬天传播很快的传染病。

senses.en: likely to spread emotions or laughter to others

example.en: Her infectious laughter filled the whole room.
example.zh: 她富有感染力的笑声传遍了整个房间。

senses.en: to refuse to buy, use, or take part in something as a protest
senses.zh: 联合抵制；拒绝购买或参与

example.en: Consumers boycotted the company over its labor practices.
example.zh: 消费者因该公司的用工行为而抵制它。

senses.en: an act of refusing to buy or take part in something as a protest

example.en: The boycott forced the airline to change its policy.
example.zh: 抵制行动迫使这家航空公司改变政策。

senses.en: a long thin straight bar made of metal, wood or other material

example.en: He used a fishing rod to catch a trout.
example.zh: 他用钓鱼竿钓到了一条鳟鱼。

senses.en: a thin stick used to hit someone as punishment, or a symbol of authority or discipline
senses.zh: 笞条；棍棒（旧时体罚用具）；纪律制裁

example.en: In the past, teachers sometimes used a rod to punish students.
example.zh: 过去，老师有时用戒尺惩罚学生。

senses.en: a rod-shaped structure or cell, such as a photoreceptor cell in the retina or a rod-shaped bacterium
senses.zh: 杆状细胞（视杆细胞）；杆状细菌

example.en: Rods in the retina help us see in dim light.
example.zh: 视网膜中的视杆细胞帮助我们在昏暗光线下看东西。

senses.en: a large building for storing goods

example.en: They stored the furniture in a warehouse until the house was ready.
example.zh: 他们把家具存放在仓库里，直到房子准备好。

senses.en: to store goods in a warehouse

example.en: The company warehouses its products before shipping them to stores.
example.zh: 公司在把产品运往商店之前先存入仓库。

senses.en: a failure of a machine or system to work

example.en: We had a breakdown on the highway, so we called a tow truck.
example.zh: 我们的车在高速公路上抛锚了，所以叫了拖车。

senses.en: a collapse of mental or physical health

example.en: Stress from work led to a nervous breakdown last year.
example.zh: 工作压力导致他去年精神崩溃。

senses.en: a division of something into categories or parts; an analysis

example.en: The report gives a breakdown of costs by department.
example.zh: 这份报告给出了各部门成本的明细。

senses.en: polite and respectful behavior; a polite act or remark

example.en: He thanked the staff as a matter of courtesy.
example.zh: 出于礼貌，他向工作人员道了谢。

senses.en: the act of doing or saying something again

example.en: Repetition is an effective way to learn new vocabulary.
example.zh: 重复是学习新词汇的有效方法。

senses.en: something that is said or done again

example.en: The concert was a repetition of last year's show.
example.zh: 这场音乐会是去年演出的重演。

senses.en: changing position or direction frequently

example.en: The desert is covered with shifting sands.
example.zh: 沙漠中遍布流动的沙丘。

senses.en: the act of moving from one place or state to another

example.en: The shifting of furniture left marks on the floor.
example.zh: 挪动家具在地板上留下了痕迹。

senses.en: furniture and other movable items that make a room or home usable and comfortable, usually in the plural
senses.zh: 家具及陈设品（常用复数）

example.en: They bought new furnishings for the apartment.
example.zh: 他们为这套公寓购置了新家具和陈设品。

senses.en: a narrow flat surface projecting from a cliff or wall
senses.zh: 岩架；壁架；突出的狭窄平台

example.en: A mountain goat stood on a rocky ledge.
example.zh: 一只山羊站在岩石突出的窄台上。

senses.en: a ridge of rock under water or a layer of ore in the ground

example.en: The ship struck an underwater ledge.
example.zh: 那艘船撞上了水下的岩礁。

senses.en: a seed of an Asian plant, widely grown for food, oil, and animal feed

example.en: Soybeans are used to make oil and tofu.
example.zh: 大豆被用来制作食用油和豆腐。

senses.en: someone who enters a place without permission

example.en: An intruder broke into the house last night.
example.zh: 昨晚有陌生人闯进了房子。

senses.en: covering a large area or wide in scope

example.en: They enjoyed a view of the expansive plains.
example.zh: 他们欣赏着广阔平原的景色。

senses.en: friendly, open, and willing to talk

example.en: He was in an expansive mood at the party.
example.zh: 他在聚会上心情开朗，谈兴很浓。

senses.en: able or likely to expand or grow

example.en: The company adopted an expansive growth strategy.
example.zh: 公司采取了扩张性的增长战略。

senses.en: great sadness shown after the death of a loved person

example.en: The family is still in mourning after the loss.
example.zh: 失去亲人后，这家人仍沉浸在悲痛之中。

senses.en: black clothes worn to show grief for a death

example.en: She wore mourning for several months.
example.zh: 她服丧数月。

senses.en: a thin mixture of solid particles in liquid, usually water

example.en: The workers pumped the coal slurry into the storage tank.
example.zh: 工人们把煤浆抽进储罐里。

senses.en: to add something, especially text or data, to the end of a document or file

example.en: Please append your signature to the end of the letter.
example.zh: 请在信的末尾附上你的签名。

senses.en: abnormally thin and weak, often from illness or hunger

example.en: The rescued dog looked weak and emaciated.
example.zh: 那只获救的狗看起来虚弱憔悴。

senses.en: not paying attention; careless of danger or consequences

example.en: Heedless of the warning signs, they kept driving through the storm.
example.zh: 他们不顾警告标志，继续在暴风雨中开车。

senses.en: (British) a current of cool air flowing through a room

example.en: Close the door; there's a cold draught in here.
example.zh: 关上门，这里有冷风。

senses.en: (British) a drink, especially beer, drawn from a keg

example.en: He ordered a pint of draught at the pub.
example.zh: 他在酒吧点了一品脱生啤。

senses.en: (British) the depth of water a ship needs to float

example.en: The ship's draught is too deep for this shallow harbor.
example.zh: 这艘船的吃水太深，不适合这个浅水港。

senses.en: relating to hydrochloric acid, a strong acid made of hydrogen and chlorine

example.en: The stomach produces hydrochloric acid to help digest food.
example.zh: 胃分泌盐酸帮助消化食物。

senses.en: not allowed by law; illegal

example.en: The court ruled that the charges were illegitimate.
example.zh: 法院裁定这些指控不合法。

senses.en: born to parents who are not married (dated or legal use)
senses.zh: 私生的（旧式或法律用语）

example.en: In the past, illegitimate children faced legal discrimination.
example.zh: 过去，私生子女在法律上受到歧视。

senses.en: not acceptable or justified

example.en: Critics called the price increase illegitimate.
example.zh: 批评者称这次涨价不合理。

senses.en: to warn someone firmly about their behavior

example.en: The teacher admonished the students for talking in class.
example.zh: 老师告诫学生不要在课堂上讲话。

senses.en: to gently advise someone about what they should do

example.en: She admonished him to be more careful with his spending.
example.zh: 她劝他在花钱上要更谨慎。

senses.en: the origin or beginning of something

example.en: The genesis of the project was a casual conversation.
example.zh: 这个项目的起源是一次随意的交谈。

senses.en: the first book of the Bible

example.en: The story of creation appears in Genesis.
example.zh: 创世的故事出现在《创世记》中。

senses.en: a portable musical instrument with a bellows and keyboard, played by pushing and pulling while pressing keys

example.en: She played a lively tune on the accordion at the festival.
example.zh: 她在节日上用手风琴演奏了一首欢快的曲子。

senses.en: folded into pleats like an accordion

example.en: The car has an accordion folder door in the back.
example.zh: 这辆车后部有一扇折叠式车门。

senses.en: to form crystals, or to cause something to form crystals

example.en: The sugar crystallized as the syrup cooled.
example.zh: 糖浆冷却时糖结晶了。

senses.en: to make an idea clear and definite, or become so
senses.zh: 使具体化；（想法）变得清晰明确

example.en: Her plans finally crystallized after months of thinking.
example.zh: 经过几个月的思考，她的计划终于清晰成型。

senses.en: at only fifty percent of the usual price

example.en: All winter coats are selling half-price this week.
example.zh: 本周所有冬衣半价出售。

senses.en: costing fifty percent of the usual price

example.en: Students can get half-price tickets at the cinema.
example.zh: 学生在电影院可以买半价票。

senses.en: brave, determined and resolute, in the way traditionally expected of a man
senses.zh: 勇敢的；坚定的；有男子气概的

example.en: He made a manful effort to finish the difficult climb.
example.zh: 他勇敢地努力完成这次艰难的攀登。

senses.en: plural of nucleus; the central part of a cell that controls its activity

example.en: The nuclei of these cells were examined under a microscope.
example.zh: 这些细胞的核在显微镜下被检查。

senses.en: plural of nucleus; the dense central core of an atom

example.en: Atoms have nuclei made of protons and neutrons.
example.zh: 原子的核由质子和中子构成。
